CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: DOM XSS: handleFiles() includes attacker-controlled file.name in validation errors (upload.js:73-75); showErrors() interpolates errors into innerHTML (215-218) without escaping. A user selecting/dropping a maliciously named file can execute attacker-controlled HTML event handlers in the gallery origin, even when the upload is rejected. Also HomeController.uploadPhotos() returns originalFileName unchanged (78), which createPhotoCard() interpolates into alt/text HTML (185-189) inserted by displayNewPhotos() at 157. Requires victim interaction with an attacker-supplied filename; not an anonymous stored gallery-view XSS. Thymeleaf server-rendered filenames are escaped.
